reason: I have one or two chairs and I am cutting hair myself all day, so I already see who is in the chair and I count the drawer every night. I paid for salon software once and nobody used it, and ₹999 a month plus ₹4,999 setup is a lot of haircuts for something I don't need.
objection: My staff are busy with customers; they won't type every walk-in's number and bill into an app, same as last time, and I'll be paying for something that sits unused.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a much lower monthly price, and seeing another small barber like me whose staff actually still use it after three months.
